mLocKeys.keyTooltip: Bel'Veth did not slay Baron Nashor, preventing her from reaching her true strength.

Slaying Baron Nashor has empowered Bel'Veth.

Killing Jax now drops Void Coral that grants Bel'Veth her true form.

“The fire of Icathia dims. My sea of silence reigns eternal.”
Bel'Veth is in her true form, gaining an overwhelming amount of benefits.
This unit is <status>Slowed</status> while Bel'Veth is transforming.

Bel'Veth's grand design starts with the cry of the Baron. Contributing to taking Baron Nashor permanently enhances Bel'veth and dooms Jax.

“None will stand in my way, not even the Icathian warrior. All will end in my beginning.”
Bel'Veth takes reduced damage and repeatedly Attacks the lowest Health enemy.

mLocKeys.keySummary: Bel'Veth roots herself in place, channeling a storm of slashes around her that targets the lowest-health enemy and grants her lifesteal and damage reduction.
mLocKeys.keyTooltip:
Bel'Veth channels and slashes around herself, gaining @DRPercent*100@% Damage Reduction, @TotalLifesteal@ Life Steal, and Attacking @f2.0@ times over @TotalDuration@ seconds with the number of Attacks increasing based on her Attack Speed. Each Attack strikes the lowest-health enemy, dealing @DamagePerStrike@ to @MaxDamagePerStrikeTooltip@ physical damage based on the target's missing Health.

Using another Ability or Recasting ends this Ability early.
mLocKeys.keyTooltipExtendedBelowLine: Attacks from this Ability deal @MonsterMod*100@% damage to monsters and apply On-Hit Effects at @OnHitRatio*100@% to @OnHitRatio*200@% effectiveness based on the target's missing Health.

mLocKeys.keySummary: Bel'Veth gains permanent attack speed stacks after taking down large minions and monsters and champions. She also gains temporary bonus attack speed after using an ability.
mLocKeys.keyTooltip:
After using an Ability, Bel'Veth becomes Ghosted and gains @SheenSpeedPerStack@ Attack Speed for @SheenDuration@ seconds.

Bel'veth gains @MonsterStacks@ Lavender stack for large minion and monster takedowns and @ChampionStacks@ Lavender stacks for champion and epic monster takedowns. Each stack permanently grants @AttackSpeedPerStack@% Attack Speed.

Total bonus Attack Speed: @TotalAttackSpeedFromStacks@%
mLocKeys.keyTooltipExtended:
{{Spell_BelvethPassive_Tooltip}}

Bel'Veth does not gain Attack Speed on level up and has no cap on Attack Speed.
{{Reminder_Ghosted}}

mLocKeys.keyTooltip:
Shh.... it will all be over soon...
Bel'Veth has assimilated @f2@% Attack Speed from her prey

mLocKeys.keySummary: Bel'Veth dashes in a chosen direction and damages all enemies she passes through.
mLocKeys.keyTooltip:
Bel'Veth dashes, dealing @BaseDamage@ physical damage to enemies she passes through.

Each direction has an unique Cooldown of @f1@ seconds that scales down based on her Attack Speed.
mLocKeys.keyTooltipExtendedBelowLine:
Applies On-Hit Effects to the first target hit.
Each 1% Attack Speed is equivalent to @PerSideCDAttackSpeedMultiplier@ Ability Haste for this Ability's per-direction Cooldown.
Bel'Veth does an additional @MonsterMod@ physical damage to monsters.

mLocKeys.keySummary: Bel'Veth consumes Void coral remnants, transforming into her true form and increasing her max health, attack range, and attack speed. Consuming the Void coral remnants of a Void epic monster will grant her the power to summon Void remora.
mLocKeys.keyTooltip:
Passive: Attacks deal an additional @FinalOnHitDamage@ true damage, stacking infinitely. Takedowns against champions and epic monsters leave behind a piece of Void Coral.

Active: Bel'Veth consumes a Void Coral, gaining @PassiveStacksOnDevour@ Lavender stack and activating her true form. Void Coral from void epic monsters causes minions that die nearby to become Void Remora. While casting, Bel'Veth Slows nearby enemies before exploding, dealing @TotalExplosionDamage@ + @MissingHealthDamage*100@% missing-Health true damage.

In her true form, Bel'Veth gains @MaxHealthOnDevour@ max Health, @BonusAARange@ Attack range, @TotalASMod*100@% Total Attack Speed, and Void Surge can pass through walls.

True form lasts @SteroidDuration@ seconds, increased to @SteroidDurationUpgrade@ seconds at @StackThresholdForUpgrade@ Lavender stacks. At @StackThresholdForPermanent@ Lavender stacks, true form lasts until death.
mLocKeys.keyTooltipExtendedBelowLine:
Void Remora count as lane minions with @VoidlingHPScale*100@% Health and @VoidlingADScale*100@% Attack Damage.
The applied Slow ramps up to 99% while Bel'Veth consumes Void Coral.
The passive deals a maximum of @MaxMonsterOnHitTooltip@ true damage to epic monsters.
While in true form, consuming Void Coral renews the form's duration and restores @BaseMaxHealth@ Health.

mLocKeys.keySummary: Bel'Veth slams her tail to the ground, damaging, knocking up, and slowing her enemies.
mLocKeys.keyTooltip: Bel'Veth slams her tail, dealing <magicDamage>@Damage@ magic damage</magicDamage>, <status>Knocking Up</status> foes for @Duration@ seconds, and <status>Slowing</status> them by @SlowPercent*100@% for @SlowDuration@ seconds. If a champion is hit, this refreshes the Cooldown of <spellName>Void Surge</spellName> in that direction.
